newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 567c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 1c to 567c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose by one cent to 567 cents a kg clean at sales in Sydney and Adelaide on Wednesday, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19/20 microns unchanged and 21/22m slightly cheaper.
The 23/24m category was 0.5 percent dearer and 25/26/27m 1.0 percent dearer, WI said.
In crossbreds, 28m was 0.5 percent dearer and 29/30/31m were 3.0 percent dearer.
Cardings were mixed, with lambs slightly cheaper and locks up to 1.0 percent dearer. Crutchings were slightly dearer, WI said.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with good support from Taiwan and local mills.
Of the 28,315 bales offered in both centres, 8.6 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Thursday in Sydney, Adelaide and Fremantle with about 40,000 bales to be offered.
